description: Use when you need a weather forecast, the current weather, temperature, rain or wind for the next hours or days at given coordinates. Do not use for historical weather, severe weather alerts or places given only by name (geocode first). Returns JSON with the weather forecast for a latitude and longitude: hourly temperature, rain and precipitation, wind, humidity and cloud cover for the next days, from MET Norway for 0.003 USDC per call. Typical response time 1500 ms (p95). Category: Data.

hours.description: How many hours ahead to return (1-240, 48 when omitted); hourly at first, then every 6 hours

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), e.g. 59.9139 for Oslo, rounded to 4 decimals

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), e.g. 10.7522 for Oslo, rounded to 4 decimals

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

name: blackwood_weather_forecast

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: Weather forecast
